name: Chess Hint Assistant
description: Chess hint assistant with Coach Mode, turn-based analysis, and multi-level hints (L1-L5). v8.5.0: Bug-fix release — restored source badge / version tag UI, wired Berserker style into UI, removed dead code, fixed Masters Explorer score perspective, SAN +/# suffixes, real engine-correlation guard, depth-target setting, player-perspective eval display, Lichess analysis link, ECO database externalised, chrome.alarms keep-alive. Preserves v7.5.0: 3-API rotation engine with health-based round-robin, cache-only enrichment, anti-ban jitter, and human-like master game recommendations.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src https://lichess.org https://explorer.lichess.ovh https://tablebase.lichess.ovh https://chess-api.com;
